client_admin: Create the ASPs and their first administrator from Organizations.
Import sites and warehouses, and the catalog of models.
Invite and manage users; the Admin log records every action.
Set branding, sign-in options and the privacy notice in Settings.
client_office: Your role sees everything and changes nothing.
Dashboards, items and reports arrive in the next versions.
client_warehouse: You confirm the arrival of return shipments at the client warehouse.
The confirmation screen arrives in the next versions.
asp_admin: Invite the people of your ASP from People: warehouse workers and technicians.
Deactivate someone who leaves; use Block now only for a lost phone.
You can also do everything a warehouse worker does.
asp_warehouse: Choose your warehouse: it stays selected for the session.
Arrivals, sorting and shipments are recorded by scanning.
Watch the top bar: online/offline and scans waiting to be sent.
asp_technician: Search the site by code or name: it works offline.
Choose Remove or Install and scan the pieces.
Install the app on the Home Screen and do not sign out while scans are waiting.
